card.name: Tolerate in dose-reduction instructions
card.fires_on: The word "tolerate" (or its start, "toler") after "unable to" or "does not" in dose-reduction and discontinuation instructions, just before a dose amount.

modes.label: Unable to tolerate
modes.description: "Tolerate" follows "unable to" in a rule to permanently discontinue if a reduced dose is not tolerated.
modes.example: Permanently discontinue pomalidomide capsules if unable to<< tolerate>> 1mg once daily.

modes.label: Does not tolerate
modes.description: "Tolerate" follows "does not" when describing a patient who cannot stay on a dose.
modes.example: If a patient does not<< tolerate>> 100 mg twice daily,
